const id = Symbol("id");
const tag = Symbol.for("tag");
let loose = Symbol("loose");
const user = { [id]: 7, [tag]: "t", name: "a" };
const n: string = user[id];
const t: number = user[tag];
console.log(user[loose]);
const other = Symbol("other");
console.log(user[other]);
let widened = id;
const kept: typeof id = widened;
const same: typeof id = id;
const notSame: typeof other = id;
class Keys {
  static readonly key = Symbol("key");
  static plain = Symbol("plain");
}
const byKey = { [Keys.key]: 1 };
const k: string = byKey[Keys.key];
interface Shape { [id]: number }
const shape: Shape = { [id]: "x" };
const missing: Shape = {};
